column1: # Curated JWST distance-anchor seed for diagnostic-only CF4 catalogue linkage.
# These galaxies have published JWST-based distances (TRGB / JAGB / Cepheid); the seed
# carries the anchor identity + the published JWST distance-modulus precision (jwst_e_dm_mag)
# NOT a re-derived distance. No CF4-conditioned precision/global-tilt forecast is
# authorized while N-DATA-CF4-DOWNSTREAM is OPEN. The authoritative machine-readable
# tables are fetched by dl_pipeline/scripts/download_jwst_anchors.py; this seed keeps
#          Riess et al. 2024/2025 (SH0ES JWST Cepheids). Coordinates are J2000 host centres.
# --- v8-update additions (2026-07-10): independently verified from the raw arXiv tables.
# CCHP = Freedman et al. 2024 status report arXiv:2408.06153 Table 2 (TRGB/JAGB adopted
# average sigma-bar = combined STATISTICAL error; zeropoint systematic additional/correlated);
# SH0ES = Riess et al. 2024 arXiv:2401.04773 Table 3 (JWST+HST NIR Cepheid P-L
# Anand & Riess 2024 (2401.04776) per-host values are narrative-only -> NOT seeded.
